belief.quote: Hong Kong SMEs don't lack tools — they have too many, and every one of them speaks a different language.
belief.body: So LegionOne was built as one system from day one: quotes, orders, invoices, collections, inventory and customers, all running on the same source of truth. Every department reads the same number.

dayFlow.headline: Five decisions a day that would otherwise eat your evenings.
dayFlow.lead: Same hours, different habits, different outcome. This is a full trading day inside LegionOne — from quote to reconciliation.

steps.title: Quotes — one version
steps.desc: A customer wants stock. Costs, tax and lead time are pulled from the same system, so every revision of the quote stays on one version.

steps.title: Orders — one entry, four places
steps.desc: Once the customer confirms, the quote becomes an order; stock, purchase orders and follow-ups all update together.

steps.title: Invoices — ageing updates live
steps.desc: Invoices issue straight from the order and AR/AP ageing refreshes immediately, so you know what is outstanding before month-end.

steps.title: Collections — the list builds itself
steps.desc: Ageing reports generate the collection list and the cash-flow forecast updates with it — no more WhatsApp reminders.

steps.title: Reconciliation — variances itemised
steps.desc: Bank statements import and accounts reconcile automatically, so variances are itemised instead of checked cell by cell in Excel.

industryCases.headline: One system, two ways of working.
industryCases.lead: The workflow can be shared, but the details have to match the trade. These are the two lines LegionOne knows best.

methodology.headline: We won't start from zero. We won't ask you to bend either.
methodology.lead: Going live isn't just swapping software. We work in three steps, and each one starts by looking at how you actually operate today.

steps.title: Map what you have
steps.desc: We map the tools and processes you use today, and mark where work is duplicated or the numbers stop matching.

steps.title: Start from a template
steps.desc: You begin from an industry template instead of assembling every module, then we match it to how you actually work.

steps.title: Live and tune
steps.desc: We tune the workflow and the reports against real operations. The system should fit you, not the other way around.

securityBadges.headline: Enterprise-grade security, built in from the start.

pricing.tiersTitle: Three plans that grow with you.
